summary.text: Cheri Steinmetz is a Republican member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 3 who took office in January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An insurance agent and business owner, she previously served in the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 5 from 2015 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Cheri Steinmetz was first elected to the Wyoming House in 2014 and represented District 5 until 2019.
She won the Senate District 3 Republican primary in 2018, defeating Martin Gubbels, and assumed office on January 7, 2019, succeeding Curt Meier.
She was unopposed apart from write-in votes in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, receiving 96.9%.
